key.name: monitor-connector
key.description: Connector of the monitor to draw on, such as DP-2. Empty means the left-most monitor, which is also the fallback when that connector isn't plugged in.

key.name: sheet-path
key.description: Path of the file to show. Empty means the built-in welcome text.

key.name: background-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the panel behind the text, in percent. 0 shows the text only.

key.name: padding
key.description: Space between the panel edge and the text, in pixels.

key.name: margin-x
key.description: Distance from the monitor's left edge, in pixels.

key.name: margin-y
key.description: Distance from the monitor's top edge, in pixels.
